notes.title: Thank You for Your Support
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I want to take a moment to thank everyone for supporting us so far.

We're still in the early stages, and this initial glimpse is meant to give you an idea of the overall atmosphere and what we're working on. We’ll be sharing more footage as we progress.

Invariant is heavily influenced by Half-Life 1 and Half-Life 2 in terms of gameplay design, but it’s a game that stands on its own and will offer new, unique experiences. Invariant is also inspired by John Carpenter’s The Thing. 

We’re taking our time to craft a smooth, fun, and engaging experience, and we understand how important it is to take the time to create something worth the wait.

Right now, we’re focused on polishing the game design and expanding our team, so you can expect plenty of improvements to come, especially with animations and gameplay.

So, give us a little more time—it’s only going to get better! :)

Thank you again for all your support.

Best,
Josip
